script:
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --expect 200 \
  --check method eq GET --check path eq / --save F29.proxy-root/get
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/ --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --expect 200 \
  --check path eq /
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/ --query path=echo --auth none \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.path eq echo \
  --save F29.proxy-root/slash-path-query
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --header "Origin: $S" --json '{"root": 1}' --expect 200 --check method eq POST --check path eq / \
  --save F29.proxy-root/post
control-agent-server api PUT <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --header "Origin: $S" --json '{"root": 1}' --expect 200 --check method eq PUT --check path eq / \
  --save F29.proxy-root/put
control-agent-server api PATCH <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --header "Origin: $S" --json '{"root": 1}' --expect 200 --check method eq PATCH --check path eq / \
  --save F29.proxy-root/patch
control-agent-server api DELETE <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --header "Origin: $S" --json '{"root": 1}' --expect 200 --check method eq DELETE --check path eq / \
  --save F29.proxy-root/delete
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" --expect 403
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --auth none --expect 401
